peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 0.4% above its local comparables; 17 of 36 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (29.1): 2.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 15 of 55 similar developments with a figure (the same as 2). Context, not scored: resales in 66.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,396,000 ($1,441 psf, 968–979 sq ft; 7 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,542 psf (range $1,269–1,794); 6.5% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $98,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $1,837,500 ($1,480 psf, 1,237–1,248 sq ft; 12 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,381 psf (range $1,289–1,873); 7.2% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $123,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Paya Lebar MRT about 350 m, Aljunied MRT about 710 m; closer than 22 of 63 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Geylang Methodist School (Primary) about 560 m; more than 37 of 63 similar developments (the same as 17). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 11 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 300 m), more than 56 of 63 similar developments (the same as 4); nearest hawker centre Blk 117 Aljunied Market And Food Centre about 470 m; nearest park Aljunied Park about 1,530 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Blk 117 Aljunied Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Zyanya, 2 new sales, about 700 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 1,000 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,010 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 1,530 m; Verdé Joo Chiat, 9 new sales, about 1,540 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,640 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 1,690 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 1,820 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 311 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 416 new sales and 640 resales (1,056 purchases); new sales were 39.4% of these purchases. Subsales (67) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 640 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 39 of 63 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 640 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 790 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−19%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
